title: expected_progression.json
description: 29 §6 — the product owner's statement of intent: PlayerPower per profile per checkpoint day, with a fractional tolerance band. 21 A14 grades every profile against it.

checkpointDays.description: 29 §6 — 8 per profile: days 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180. More may be added; the simulator interpolates between them for charting.

toleranceLadders.description: 29 §6.0 — named tolerance ladders. A fraction: 0.25 means actual must land within +/-25% of expected. Bands widen with time because variance compounds.

profiles.description: 29 §6.0 — one entry per simulated profile (21 §5.4). Exactly one must be marked canonical: the AllAds_Core curve every other row is derived from.

expectedPower.description: 29 §6.0 — one value per entry in checkpointDays, in the same order. Must be strictly ascending: a profile's expected power never goes down.
